title: Traffic Signal Color
goal: Solve Traffic Signal Color: Evaluate exact timer boundaries and illuminate the matching traffic signal, or return Invalid.
strategy: Evaluate exact timer boundaries and illuminate the matching traffic signal, or return Invalid.

phasePurposes.start: Read the timer without changing it.
phasePurposes.done: Return the matched color or Invalid.

edgeCases: Timer zero is Green, 30 is Orange, and values strictly above 30 through 90 are Red; other accepted timers return Invalid.
inputRules: Enter an integer timer from 0 to 1000.
